test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

It was certainly a __cowardly__ act.
solution:
The correct answer is: Brave.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cowardly"** means lacking courage; very fearful or timid. (कायर)

 
 
• **Example:** Running away from the situation was a **cowardly **act.
 
 
 
• **"Brave"** refers to showing courage; ready to face and endure danger or pain. (बहादुर)
 
 
• **Example:** The firefighter's **brave **actions saved many lives.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'cowardly'** is **'brave'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Believable** (विश्वसनीय): Capable of being believed; plausible.

 
 
• **Example:** Her story was so detailed that it seemed completely **believable**.
 
 
 
• **Fearful** (भयभीत): Feeling or showing fear or anxiety.
 
 
• **Example:** The **fearful **child clung to his mother in the dark.
 
 
 
• **Comfortable** (आरामदायक): Providing physical ease and relaxation.
 
 
• **Example:** The new sofa is very **comfortable **to sit on.
